brief.name: Skill Swap
brief.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
brief.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.
brief.intended_appearance: Warm editorial layered heavyweight matte paper and card, controlled folds, visible substantial edges and restrained fiber texture
avoid: Any non-paper material including ceramic, porcelain, metal, rubber, glass, wax or clay
A badge, medallion, backing disc, enclosing border or backing plate
Generic AI sparkles, chain links or recycling arrows
Slack hashtag or Dropbox diamond-box topology
Cohere cell cluster and Miro chevrons
Fine text or hairline geometry inside the symbol
Confusing peer-to-peer skill barter with a team AI skills library

concept.metaphor: Three different folded card parts provide open sides and a low shared shelf, making an accessible common library space without an enclosing border or backing plate.
concept.treatment: The mark itself as a solid object with depth and softly beveled edges, standing free with no backing.
concept.material: Heavy matte paper or card with a fine fiber texture.

state.intended_appearance: Warm editorial layered heavyweight matte paper and card, controlled folds, visible substantial edges and restrained fiber texture

symbol.instructions: Does `candidate` visibly express the motif described in `concept` for `brief`?

criteria.true: The described symbolic relationship is visible in the actual shapes and fits the brand direction.
criteria.false: The symbolic relationship is absent, contradicted or depends only on the written explanation.
